fact: BCPFS and ONECI signed a partnership convention on 2 April 2026 to interconnect the RSU with ONECI databases, identifying and verifying beneficiaries through the Registre National des Personnes Physiques.

KOACI reports that on 3 February 2025 Orange Bank Africa and ONECI signed a convention under which the bank will integrate ONECI's authentication solutions through APIs to verify customer identity for KYC.
